scope: Only neutral/index.json and its twelve PNGs inspected; targets, identities, mapping, history and rationale undisclosed.

hash_verification.method: SHA-256 of each PNG compared with neutral/index.json

visual_inspection.method: All twelve PNGs viewed using view_image at their supplied dimensions

A.single512: Matte khaki-beige ground with fine dusty grain and soft irregular pale mottles. Broad cloud-like variation occupies more area than individually resolved grains; faint curved or diagonal patches imply shallow surface variation without sharp edges.
A.repeat128: Pale hooked or comma-like patches recur in an orderly spacing; repetition is easier to notice than in the single tile. The fine grain is subordinate to these light marks.
A.repeat64: The recurring light flecks form a small, regularly spaced dotted texture. Individual material detail is weak.
A.repeat32: Mostly smooth beige with a faint repeated pale-dot rhythm.
A.relief_cracks: No distinct crack network or hard relief. Soft light/dark mottling can suggest faint surface undulation; no directional cast shadows.

B.single512: Very smooth matte taupe-beige surface, softly blurred cloudy mottling, almost no discrete grains or particle outlines. Reads as diffuse powder or a smooth coating more readily than an exposed aggregate.
B.repeat128: Fine cloudy texture with weak repeating light and dark patches; no strong isolated marker.
B.repeat64: Quiet, nearly uniform field with a faint fine mottled rhythm.
B.repeat32: Nearly flat beige; texture character is only weakly retained.
B.relief_cracks: No cracks, outlined stones, strong relief or directional lighting. Broad soft shading is visible but does not clearly describe geometry.

C.single512: Flat sandy yellow-beige base carrying dense discrete darker rounded and irregular spots. Spots have broadly similar size and contrast; resembles small flat embedded grains or a stippled print. Their edges are soft but substantially more defined than A or B.
C.repeat128: Dense fine dark stipple remains clearly apparent. Repeated spatial distribution is present, but no single large mark dominates.
C.repeat64: Stipple becomes a very fine mesh or grain field; texture remains more high-frequency than A or B.
C.repeat32: Largely merges into a lightly grainy sandy field; discrete spots are no longer clearly resolved.
C.relief_cracks: No cracks or strong directional shadows. The spots mostly look flat; a few may suggest shallow dimples, but no convincing raised pebble relief.

distinguishability_beyond_color: At 512 and repeated128, C is distinct through discrete dark particle-like spots, A through pale mottling and fine dusty grain, and B through soft smooth clouding. A versus B is a degree-of-texture difference rather than a strongly different structure. At repeated64 C retains finer stipple and A retains a pale-fleck rhythm; B remains smoothest. At repeated32 all approach uniform fields, with only weak textural distinctions, so color increasingly carries separation.
pattern_summary: A has the most readily legible recurring pale motif; B has subdued broad clouding; C has dense, fairly uniform spot distribution. No obvious hard tile-edge seams observed in the supplied repeats. None shows an explicit crack network.
judgment_status: No scores, approval or recommendations issued before target disclosure.
